objective: attribute the Phase3C10 live channel-processing duration to additive CIRDB update, preparation, convolution, shared-write and history-copy stages without changing the channel, trace or acceptance decisions

required_checks: all patch and build-script hashes match source_audit.json
source diff contains only the frozen UE, CIRDB, runtime and split telemetry changes
build completes for both UE and gNB images
image architecture is amd64 and revision label is the pinned OAI commit
both images contain the same newly built libvrtsim.so
VRTSIM_CIRDB_DEBUG_V1, VRTSIM_RUNTIME_DEBUG_V1 and VRTSIM_SPLIT_DEBUG_V1 markers are present

identity_execution_stage.authorization_prerequisite: commit a successful immutable build result with image IDs, sizes, architecture, revision labels, libvrtsim checksum, build log checksum and exact source diff checksum
identity_execution_stage.planned_channel: the frozen eight-tap unity-energy CIRDB identity control
identity_execution_stage.planned_topology: one gNB and one UE on the existing AWGN RFsim profile

planned_validation.row_alignment: runtime and split rows must have identical role and elapsed_second keys
planned_validation.uncertainty: moving-block bootstrap over once-per-second rows with block lengths 5, 10 and 20 seconds; report traversal-conditional intervals

decision_branches.shared_write_dominant: audit shm_td_iq_channel_tx blocking, locking and timing semantics before optimizing
decision_branches.cirdb_update_dominant: prototype prefetched or memory-mapped snapshot publication offline
decision_branches.convolution_dominant_only_live: instrument task-queue wait and worker scheduling rather than altering arithmetic partitioning
decision_branches.preparation_or_history_dominant: isolate allocation, pointer/tap preparation and copy costs with a focused microbenchmark
decision_branches.no_dominant_stage_or_total_mismatch: do not optimize; add per-call trace and scheduler evidence
decision_branches.telemetry_validation_failure: reject the split result and keep all replay/calibration gates closed

prohibited: changing thresholds after observing split timings
